newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest hogs called $0.50-$1.00 lower - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest hogs called $0.50-$1.00 lower - trade.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hogs were expected to trade $0.50 to $1.00 per cwt lower at interior markets Friday, with continued declines in cash pork prices driving hog prices down, livestock dealers said.
If the calls are accurate, it would make for five consecutive days of lower hog prices at Midwest markets.

Friday's slaughter needs are largely covered with some packers bought into Monday. Very few meat packers were planning Saturday slaughter operations, but most will operate full slaughter shifts Friday.
